quote: Der Münchner Kapitalgeber hält bereits 16 % an Westwing. Daneben sind noch die Business Angels Christoph Janz und Klaus Neuhaus bei der gerade abgeschlossenen Kapitalerhöhung bei Westwing an Bord gegangen, die jeweils 2 % der Anteile halten.
notes: HV's pre-launch capital increase of mid-2011 is not named as a series. Cross-book context, not an HV label: Point Nine joined Westwing's second financing in Sept 2011 (deutsche-startups 2011-09-04), which Point Nine's live card calls Pre-seed (its CMS and lists say Seed). HV's round came before that one.

quote: Wind Mobility, a Berlin-based mobility startup that offers “dockless” e-scooter (and electric bicycle) rentals, has raised $22 million in seed funding ... Investing in Wind Mobility’s rather large seed round is Chinese Source Code Capital, and Europe’s HV Holtzbrinck Ventures.
notes: HV's entry was the $22M (EUR 19.2M) seed with Source Code Capital. A $50M Series A followed in July 2019. Later state: in Dec 2021 Tier bought only Wind's Italian unit, Vento Mobility (Zag Daily, Tech Funding News, phocuswire headlines). The parent's fate was not established, so no status update.

quote: An der Jungfirma waren zuletzt vor allem Neuhaus Partners (24 %), T-Venture (24 %), High-Tech Gründerfonds (23 %) und Holtzbrinck Ventures (12 %) beteiligt.

status_update.event: next idea (Münster; Looki group, via Enjoy Games) bought all shares of wwg worldwidegames, the operator of the browser-games platform playnik, in April 2012; price not disclosed.

notes: wwg worldwidegames (Hamburg, 'die Hanseaten') ran playnik (launched 2008). HV held 12% at the sale. No round word for HV's entry was found.

quote: Yapily ... has raised $5.4 million in seed funding. Leading the round is HV Holtzbrinck Ventures and LocalGlobe.
notes: HV co-led the $5.4M seed with LocalGlobe. HV's own entry date (2018-07) is ten months before the May 2019 announcement, which TechCrunch's April 2020 piece calls the seed 'last disclosed' in May 2019. So the seed was disclosed after it closed; no separate earlier HV round was found. The '$5.4M round of May 2019' in the note is this seed.

quote: Finanzielle Unterstützung bekommt das Team um Geschäftsführer Zapart ebenfalls aus Deutschland: Holtzbrinck Ventures (auch an deutsche-startups.de beteiligt) ist ab sofort bei YouTailor als Kapitalgeber an Bord.
notes: HV's Oct 2009 entry is not named as a series. For the status judge: YouTailor filed for insolvency in July 2012 (deutsche-startups 2012-07-13). The filing was withdrawn in Aug 2012 when Christian Heitmeyer's Pearl Bay Beteiligungs GmbH invested and the business carried on (deutsche-startups 2012-08-20). The state after that was not found, so no status change.

quote: Nach dem Samwer-Clan hat nun auch Holtzbrinck Ventures seine Beteiligungen an den Mode-Startups Enamora (seit Juni 2008), Zalando (seit September 2008) und 7trends (seit März 2009) offengelegt.
notes: HV has been a shareholder since Sept 2008 (Horizont, as summarised by deutsche-startups), but no round word appears for its entry. The Sept 2009 financing is also unnamed ('Die bestehenden Investoren Rocket Internet ... und Holtzbrinck Ventures gaben noch einmal frisches Geld', deutsche-startups 2009-10-15).

quote: Berlin-based Zeitgold has announced a Series A round of €10 million from Battery Ventures and Holtzbrinck Ventures . ... This Series A round follows its €4.2 million seed round in February, also from Battery and Holtzbrinck.
notes: HV's first money was the EUR 4.2M ($4.5M) seed with Battery Ventures, announced at launch on 2017-02-08 (TechCrunch). HV's own entry date is 2016-04, so the seed was likely committed before the announcement; no earlier HV round was found. CTech calls the Sept 2017 round a Series A led by Battery with HV Holtzbrinck Ventures, adding 'The two firms also invested €4.2 ($5) million in Zeitgold's February investment round.'

quote: The Series A brings the total raised by Zencargo to $20 million. This latest round was led by HV Holtzbrinck Ventures. Tom Stafford, managing partner at DST Global; Pentland Ventures; and previous investors Samos, LocalGlobe and Picus Capital also participated in the round.
notes: HV led the ~$19M Series A (announced 2019-04-16; the firm's own entry date is 2019-05). HV is not among the earlier investors (Samos, LocalGlobe, Picus), and LocalGlobe led the Sept 2018 seed-plus.

quote: Holtzbrinck Ventures investiert nach Informationen von deutsche-startups.de 3 Millionen Euro in das Münchner Startup Zeuz .
notes: HV's EUR 3M of Nov 2018 is not named as a series (deutsche-startups 2018-11-26 and its 2019-09-18 profile, which lists Vito Ventures and Holtzbrinck Ventures together at about 11.5%). The mcv/develop piece on the Feb 2020 Improbable acquisition gives no funding history.
